Predicates:
Chases($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x chase y?
Needs($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x need y?
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Visits($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x visit y?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?

Facts:
Chases(BaldEagle, Lion, True) ::: The bald eagle chases the lion.
Chases(BaldEagle, Rabbit, True) ::: The bald eagle chases the rabbit.
Big(BaldEagle, True) ::: The bald eagle is big.
Needs(Cow, BaldEagle, True) ::: The cow needs the bald eagle.
Needs(Cow, Rabbit, True) ::: The cow needs the rabbit.
Chases(Lion, Cow, True) ::: The lion chases the cow.
Chases(Lion, Rabbit, True) ::: The lion chases the rabbit.
Kind(Lion, True) ::: The lion is kind.
Round(Lion, False) ::: The lion is not round.
Needs(Lion, BaldEagle, True) ::: The lion needs the bald eagle.
Visits(Lion, Cow, False) ::: The lion does not visit the cow.
Visits(Lion, Rabbit, True) ::: The lion visits the rabbit.
Chases(Rabbit, BaldEagle, True) ::: The rabbit chases the bald eagle.
Visits(Rabbit, BaldEagle, True) ::: The rabbit visits the bald eagle.

Rules:
Needs($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Chases(Rabbit, Lion, True) ::: If someone needs the rabbit then the rabbit chases the lion.
Rough($x, True) && Chases($x, Rabbit, False) >>> Visits($x, BaldEagle, True) ::: If someone is rough and they do not chase the rabbit then they visit the bald eagle.
Chases($x, Lion, True) >>> Needs($x, Cow, False) ::: If someone chases the lion then they do not need the cow.
Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) && Chases(BaldEagle, Cow, True) >>> Round(BaldEagle, False) ::: If someone needs the bald eagle and the bald eagle chases the cow then the bald eagle is not round.
Chases($x, BaldEagle, True) && Needs($x, Cow, False) >>> Visits($x, Cow, True) ::: If someone chases the bald eagle and they do not need the cow then they visit the cow.
Needs($x, Rabbit, True) && Visits(Rabbit, Cow, True) >>> Big(Rabbit, True) ::: If someone needs the rabbit and the rabbit visits the cow then the rabbit is big.
Big($x, True) >>> Visits($x, Lion, False) ::: If someone is big then they do not visit the lion.

Query:
Visits(Rabbit, Cow, False) ::: The rabbit does not visit the cow.
